notes.title: tntodion update release date
notes.content: hello! We forgot to say that in November 2022 we suspended the development of TNTODION. We will continue it this summer with new thoughts and release a really good game. We update the character models, locations, and so on. also, many players complained about the optimization. we ask you to be patient and thank you for staying with us.

tags.feature: We update the character models, locations, and so on.

tags.bug: also, many players complained about the optimization.

notes.title: Update 2.5b1
notes.content:
- Added notifications about new characters.
- Added a TV to the menu. By clicking on it, you can find out about all the open characters, as well as find out their description.
- Added new buttons in the settings, R.L.O - removes objects loading the system.
- Added buttons to turn off sounds or music
- Fixed bugs

notes.title: Update 1.1.3b4
notes.content:

2. Bugs fixed
